title: Yummy Cheesy Dutch Shrimp Gratin
description: A pungent and cozy Dutch dish featuring shrimp, mirepoix base, and ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients, with a delicious cheese pull.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook until they are pink and fully cooked.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with the gruyere and parmesan cheese.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the gratin from the oven and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve the gratin hot and enjoy.
